scope.target_boundary: Local request failure within the declared observation window; no organizational why.

causal_conditions.statement: The Content-Encoding header changes to deflate although the response bytes remain a gzip stream.

causal_edges.mechanism: The encoded body SHA256 is identical in all three phases; changing only the declared encoding causes failure and changing it back restores the same document.

reference_mechanism.causal_condition: The Content-Encoding header changes to deflate although the response bytes remain a gzip stream.
reference_mechanism.mechanism: The consumer follows the header and passes gzip bytes to the zlib deflate decoder, which fails; restoring gzip selects the matching decoder.
reference_mechanism.reference_explanation: The encoded body SHA256 is identical in all three phases; changing only the declared encoding causes failure and changing it back restores the same document.
limitations: This uses local byte buffers and standard-library decoders; no HTTP server, proxy or network transfer is exercised.
It identifies a declared-encoding mismatch, not why a real deployment generated such a header.
